hero.title: Issues from the floor to your team
hero.lead: WinProx links QR reports to tasks for internal facility teams — without scattered spreadsheets or email chains.

cards.title: Reports get lost
cards.body: Issues arrive by email, phone or paper — nobody sees the full status.

cards.title: No clear owner
cards.body: Technical, cleaning and facility teams work in parallel without clear task assignment.

cards.title: Slow follow-up
cards.body: Managers search folders and chats instead of one overview per site and team.

solution.title: One line from report to task
solution.lead: Scan a QR code on a unit, report the issue, and assign it to the right internal team. Field workers see tasks in the portal — managers keep overview on desktop.

items.title: Issues & moderation
items.body: Approve QR submissions; manager issues start with a task immediately.

items.title: Tasks per team
items.body: Four clear statuses, briefing and calendar for planning.

items.title: Sites & units
items.body: Manage locations, units, QR stickers and documents in one place.

items.title: Teams & workers
items.body: Internal teams with field workers via QR — no extra login on site.

items.title: Recurring maintenance
items.body: Schedule cycles and see due dates in the calendar.

items.title: Trial & scale
items.body: Start with a trial; choose a plan that fits your size later.

steps.title: Scan QR
steps.body: Someone scans the code on a unit and describes the issue (optional photos).

steps.title: Task to team
steps.body: Management assigns an internal team; the team gets a task in the portal.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Follow-up and status stay visible until the issue is completed or closed.

cta_band.title: Ready to start?
cta_band.body: Create an account and set up your first location in minutes.
